an8.6:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] aṭṭhime bhikkhave, lokadhammā lokaṃ anuparivattanti, loko ca aṭṭha lokadhamme anuparivattati.
an8.6:1.3: lābho ca alābho ca yaso ca ayaso ca nindā ca pasaṃsā ca sukhaṃ ca dukkhaṃ ca,
an8.6:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave, aṭṭhalokadhammā lokaṃ anuparivattanti. loko ca ime aṭṭhalokadhamme anuparivattati.
an8.6:2.1: assutavato bhikkhave, puthujjanassa uppajjati lābhopi alābhopi yasopi ayasopi nindāpi pasaṃsāpi sukhampi dukkhampi.
an8.6:2.2: sutavatopi kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa uppajjati lābhopi alābhopi, yasopi ayasopi nindāpi pasaṃsāpi sukhampi dukkhampi.
an8.6:2.3: tatra bhikkhave, ko viseso ko adhippayāso kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenāti:
an8.6:2.4: bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā, bhagavannettikā, bhagavampaṭisaraṇā. sādhu vata bhante, bhagavantaṃyeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho, bhagavato sutvā bhikkhu dhāressantīti.
an8.6:3.1: tena hi bhikkhave, suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmīti.
an8.6:3.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an8.6:3.7: so ca kho anicco dukkho viparināmadhammoti, yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an8.6:3.17: taṃ ca kho aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammanti. yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an8.6:4.1: tassa lābhopi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, alobho pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, yasopi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, ayasopi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, nindā pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, pasaṃsāpi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati. sukhampi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, dukkhampi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
an8.6:4.2: so uppannaṃ lābhaṃ anurujjhati, alābhe paṭivirujjhati.
an8.6:4.6: so evaṃ anurodhavirodhasamāpanno na parimuccati, jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi,
an8.6:5.1: sutavato ca kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa uppajjati lābho.
an8.6:5.4: so ca kho anicco dukkho viparināmadhammoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an8.6:5.14: tañca kho aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an8.6:6.1: tassa lābhopi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati. alobhopi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, yasopi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, ayasopi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, nindāpi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, pasaṃsāpi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, sukhampi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, dukkhampi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
an8.6:6.2: so uppannaṃ lābhaṃ nānurujjhati, alābhe nappaṭivirujjhati.
an8.6:6.6: so evaṃ anurodhavirodhavippahīno parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi.
an8.6:6.8: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave, viseso ayaṃ adhippayāso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenāti.
